context:
ACCORD-1234: As a user, I want to refresh my auth token without being redirected to login.

Acceptance Criteria:
- AC-1: When access token expires, the system automatically refreshes using the stored refresh token
- AC-2: If refresh fails, redirect to login with a flash message
- AC-3: Refresh token TTL is configurable via AUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL env var
